title: Minimum Number of Flips to Make Binary Grid Palindromic II
summary: Return the minimum number of cells to flip so every row and column is a palindrome and the total number of ones is divisible by 4.
officialConstraints: Not obtained (grid dimension limits not in the sources reached).
examples: No example from the statement was obtained. Grid examples are illustrative (not from the statement).
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts grids up to 6 by 6. Solution uses 4-cell mirror orbits and a 4-state remainder table; checked by brute force on small grids.
